title: FILTER over VALUES of the column, unlike ALL, keeps the existing filter
query: DEFINE MEASURE Sales[OnlyRed Values] = CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], FILTER ( VALUES ( 'Product'[Color] ), 'Product'[Color] = "Red" ) )

source.quote: in the OnlyRed_Values measure the filter over the Color column intersects the filter of the color in the row
source.supports: with VALUES the filter on Color intersects the color of the row

source.quote: CALCULATE evaluates all the explicit filter arguments in the original evaluation context, each one independently from the others.
source.supports: VALUES ( Product[Color] ) is evaluated in the context of the row, where only that row's color is visible

derivation: On the Red row VALUES ( Product[Color] ) is { Red }; the filter keeps Red: 460. On the Blue and Green rows VALUES holds only that color, FILTER returns no rows, and an empty filter gives BLANK.
notes: SUM of a fixed decimal (currency) column is taken to be a fixed decimal, as in the seed cases.
